mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_certificate ec WHERE ec.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id from employee e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_career( employee_id, company_name, hire_date, resignation_date, position_name, department_name, resignation_reason ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{companyName}, #{hireDate}, #{resignationDate}, #{positionName}, #{departmentName}, #{resignationReason} )
